drug_class: High-potency topical corticosteroid (steroid applied to the skin)
purpose: This medicated solution is used to reduce redness, swelling, itching, and irritation caused by certain skin conditions like eczema, psoriasis, or allergic reactions. It works on the scalp and skin to calm inflammation and relieve discomfort. Your doctor prescribed it to help control a skin flare-up or ongoing skin condition.
how_it_works: This medication contains a steroid that calms down your immune system's overreaction in the skin. Think of it like turning down the volume on the inflammation that causes redness and itching. It does not cure the underlying condition, but it helps control the symptoms so your skin can heal.
common_side_effects: Burning, stinging, or itching right after you apply it. You might notice some skin dryness, redness, or mild irritation at the application site. Occasionally, the skin may thin slightly if used for a long time or in large amounts.
warnings: Do not use this on your face, underarms, or groin unless your doctor specifically tells you to, as the skin there absorbs more medication. Never cover the treated area with tight bandages or wraps unless instructed, as this can increase absorption into your body. Do not use it near your eyes or mouth. Using too much for too long can affect your body's natural hormone levels, so always follow your doctor's instructions carefully. Keep away from children.
typical_dosing: Usually apply a thin layer to the affected area 2 to 3 times a day, or exactly as directed by your doctor. A little goes a long way — use just enough to cover the area with a thin film. Do not use it more often or for longer than your doctor recommends.
